cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

mechanism: A copies a misunderstood routine and treats each resulting inconvenience as the opportunity for a cheaper or smarter replacement.
confusable: General optimism is insufficient: D44 proposes an efficiency gain and S04 shows borrowed certainty without understanding.
comparison: Recurring movement costs at home versus serving a meal with scarce dishes.
seedUse: Retain practical stairs/shopping and bread/curry pressure, but make imitation causal.
